DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_id as "incidentReportId", incident_type_task_id as "incidentTypeTaskId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_task_elements (incident_report_id, incident_type_task_id, element_type_id, element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportId, :incidentTypeTaskId, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_task_elements WHERE incident_report_id = :incidentReportId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND element_id = :elementId AND incident_type_task_id = :incidentTypeTaskId
